claim: Cliniko is a practice management system for healthcare practitioners.
quote: Cliniko is a practice management system for healthcare practitioners.

claim: Cliniko's API is REST and returns JSON.
quote: JSON will be returned in all responses from the API.

claim: HealthKit is a central repository for health and fitness data on iPhone and Apple Watch.
quote: HealthKit provides a central repository for health and fitness data on iPhone and Apple Watch.

claim: Accounts created in Europe are stored in Ireland, per Cliniko.
quote: For those of you creating your account in Europe, we've got you covered with data storage in Ireland

claim: The user's device stores all HealthKit data locally.
quote: The user's device stores all HealthKit data locally.

claim: Cliniko's connected-apps directory lists 96 apps (re-counted November 5, 2026).
quote: All apps ( 96 )

claim: Most connected apps were developed by third parties.
quote: Most of these apps were developed by third parties.

claim: The directory has a Patient care & monitoring category.
quote: Patient care & monitoring ( 12 )

claim: Help-centre search for apple health returns the Apple calendar article.
quote: Connect Cliniko to Apple /Mac Calendar

claim: Help-centre search for apple health returns the Apple Pay article.
quote: Apple Pay or Google Pay not showing up in online bookings

claim: Help-centre search for apple health returns the Apple Pencil article.
quote: Using an Apple Pencil or stylus to write treatment notes

claim: SST Trainer: reports generated from session data and filed to the Cliniko record.
quote: clearance letters and insurer reports are generated from session data and filed to the Cliniko record

claim: Vively Health: all patient data syncs to your dashboard.
quote: All patient data syncs to your dashboard.

claim: Apple: with the user's permission, apps communicate with the HealthKit store.
quote: With the user's permission, apps communicate with the HealthKit store to access and share this data.

claim: Apple: the device encrypts the HealthKit store when the user locks the device.
quote: the device encrypts the HealthKit store when the user locks the device

claim: Apple: the app may not be able to read data in the background.
quote: your app may not be able to read data from the store when it runs in the background

claim: Apple: iPadOS 16 and earlier and macOS 13 and later don't have a copy of the HealthKit store.
quote: these devices don't have a copy of the HealthKit store

claim: Apple: users grant or deny permission separately for each type.
quote: Users can grant or deny permission separately for each type of data.

claim: Apple: an app isn't aware when the user denies permission to read data.
quote: an app isn't aware when the user denies permission to read data

claim: Attachment flow step 1: presigned URL.
quote: Make a GET request for a presigned URL for the patient that you want to upload a file for.

claim: Attachment flow step 2: POST the file.
quote: make a POST request to the given URL with the file to upload

claim: Attachment flow step 3: create the patient attachment record.
quote: To finish, you must create a new patient attachment record.

claim: Cliniko will process the file.
quote: Cliniko will process the file

claim: Custom patient buttons send a GET with patient_id.
quote: Clicking on one of those buttons causes the user's browser to send a GET request to the corresponding URL

claim: Cliniko has to approve the URL.
quote: please get in contact with us so we can add its URL to our list of approved applications

claim: HTTP Basic authentication.
quote: The Cliniko API uses HTTP Basic authentication.

claim: Each Cliniko user has their own API keys.
quote: Each Cliniko user will have their own API key(s)

claim: The API key has the same permissions as its user.
quote: The API key will have the same permissions as the user it belongs to.

claim: User-Agent rule.
quote: If your requests do not include a User-Agent that contains a name and valid contact email, future requests may be automatically blocked.

claim: Rate limit 200 a minute per user.
quote: API requests are rate limited to 200 per minute per user.

claim: 429 with X-RateLimit-Reset.
quote: Requests exceeding the rate limit will receive a response with a 429 status and an X-RateLimit-Reset header

claim: Pagination: 50 by default, up to 100 with per_page.
quote: Requests that return multiple items will be paginated to 50 items by default. You can specify further pages with the page parameter. You can also set a custom page size up to 100 with the per_page parameter.

claim: Shards: the docs' example is the au1 shard.
quote: to get all the patients on a specific account in the au1 shard

claim: Polling with an updated_at filter.
quote: You can get records that have been updated since a certain time by sending a filter for updated_at

claim: Apple: must not disclose to a third party without express permission.
quote: You must not disclose any information gained through HealthKit to a third party without express permission from the user.

claim: Apple: only to a third party that also provides a health or fitness service.
quote: Even with permission, you can only share information to a third party if they also provide a health or fitness service to the user.

claim: Apple: a privacy policy for every HealthKit app.
quote: You must also provide a privacy policy for any app that uses the HealthKit framework.

claim: HHS: providers only if they transmit electronically in a standard transaction.
quote: but only if they transmit any information in an electronic form in connection with a transaction for which HHS has adopted a standard

claim: HHS lists clinics and psychologists among providers.
quote: Doctors Clinics Psychologists

claim: HHS lists chiropractors among providers.
quote: Chiropractors

claim: HHS: an app developer that contracts with a covered entity is a business associate.
quote: developer that contracts with a covered entity to provide the health care app to the covered entity's patients

claim: HHS: monitoring of patients' food and exercise.
quote: monitoring of patients' food and exercise

claim: Cliniko will set up a BAA on request.
quote: If you'd like a Business Associate Agreement (BAA), just send us a request

claim: Cliniko: some integrators may not be HIPAA-compliant.
quote: some integrators may not be HIPAA-compliant

claim: The ICO lists data from fitness trackers as health data.
quote: data from fitness trackers

claim: Cliniko offers a Data Processing Addendum.
quote: The establishment of a Data Processing Addendum (DPA)

claim: Cliniko: connected apps often require your API key.
quote: Cliniko connected apps often require your API key in order to link with your Cliniko account.

claim: Cliniko: share your API key only with parties you trust.
quote: Only share your API key with parties you trust

claim: HealthKit reads clinical records downloaded from supported institutions.
quote: Users can download their FHIR records from supported healthcare institutions.
